component.name: Sublime Prototype
component.summary: Sublime Text-feeling prototype editor built on Monaco

description.p: A proof-of-concept editor built directly on Monaco, the open-source editing component behind VS Code, aimed at Sublime Text's lean, keyboard-first feel rather than a full IDE workbench.

Includes a unified Goto Anything box (files, symbols, line numbers in one input), native multi-cursor editing, distraction-free mode, large-file performance tuning, Emmet abbreviation expansion, and inline CSS colour highlighting.

First prototype: Monaco-based shell with Goto Anything, multi-cursor editing, distraction-free mode, large-file handling, Emmet, inline colour highlighting, a redesigned status bar with a language switcher, and a Preferences panel for choosing the UI font.
